description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the CompanyStructureDao class, testing CRUD operations and tree structure management for organizational subunits within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: CompanyStructureDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for the CompanyStructureDao, verifying organizational unit management functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up DAO instance and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Verifies that setting the organization name returns the expected success indicator.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a subunit by ID, ensuring correct object type and attribute values.

methods.name: testSaveSubunit
methods.description: Tests the saving of a new Subunit object and its persistence.

methods.name: testDeleteSubunit
methods.description: Validates deletion of a subunit and the integrity of the tree structure post-deletion.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Tests the addition of a subunit under a parent, ensuring tree restructuring and correct positioning.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the hierarchical tree of subunits with correct properties.
